classification.difficultyReason: Transfer the stated distance and elevation angle onto the supplied diagram, identify height as opposite, and calculate it using tangent.

content.prompt:
Jess looks up at a building that is 72 m away. She looks up at an angle of $54^{\circ}$.
Complete the diagram then calculate the height of the building to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Building on the right, dashed line of sight from the ground at lower left, and three dedicated diagram-label regions.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal distance is adjacent to the viewing angle; building height is opposite.
spec.answerVisibility: Ground and a degree symbol are supplied; angle, distance and height labels remain blank.

answer.worked:
Label the viewing angle $54^{\circ}$, the horizontal distance $72\text{ m}$ and the building height $h$.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan54^{\circ}&=\frac{h}{72}\\72\tan54^{\circ}&=h\\h&\approx99.1\text{ m}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Completed right triangle with the viewing angle, horizontal distance and unknown height.
spec.mathematics: Adjacent side 72 m, angle 54 degrees and opposite side h.
